caption: Load configuration
doc: Creates a rules that is used as a configuration

ACZ.caption: Frequency
ACZ.doc: One of the following constants. "yearly, monthly, weekly, daily, hourly, minutely, secondly"
ACZ.name: frequency

ACa.caption: Starts On
ACa.doc: The recurrence start. Besides being the base for the recurrence, missing parameters in the final recurrence instances will also be extracted from this date. If not given, new Date will be used instead
ACa.name: starts_on

ACb.caption: Interval
ACb.doc: The interval between each freq iteration. For example, when using RRule.YEARLY, an interval of 2 means once every two years, but with RRule.HOURLY, it means once every two hours. The default interval is 1.
ACb.name: interval

ACc.caption: Week Start Day
ACc.doc: The week start day. Must be one of the following "monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday" constants, or an integer, specifying the first day of the week. This will affect recurrences based on weekly periods. The default week start is "monday" = 0.
ACc.name: week_start_day

ACd.caption: Count
ACd.doc: How many occurrences will be generated.
ACd.name: count

ACe.caption: Until
ACe.doc: If given, this must be a Date instance, that will specify the limit of the recurrence. If a recurrence instance happens to be the same as the Date instance given in the until argument, this will be the last occurrence.
ACe.name: until

ACf.caption: By Step Position
ACf.doc: Comma separated values "1,2,3".  If given, it must be either an integer, or an array of integers, positive or negative. Each given integer will specify an occurrence number, corresponding to the nth occurrence of the rule inside the frequency period. For example, a bysetpos of -1 if combined with a RRule.MONTHLY frequency, and a byweekday of (RRule.MO, RRule.TU, RRule.WE, RRule.TH, RRule.FR), will result in the last work day of every month.
ACf.name: by_step_position

ACg.caption: By Month
ACg.doc: If given, it must be either an integer, or an array of integers, meaning the months to apply the recurrence to.
ACg.name: by_month

ACh.caption: By Month Day
ACh.doc: If given, it must be either an integer, or an array of integers, meaning the month days to apply the recurrence to.
ACh.name: by_month_day

ACi.caption: By Year Day
ACi.doc: If given, it must be either an integer, or an array of integers, meaning the year days to apply the recurrence to.
ACi.name: by_year_day

ACj.caption: By Week No
ACj.doc: If given, it must be either an integer, or an array of integers, meaning the week numbers to apply the recurrence to. Week numbers have the meaning described in ISO8601, that is, the first week of the year is that containing at least four days of the new year.
ACj.name: by_week_no

ACk.caption: By Hour
ACk.doc: If given, it must be either an integer, or an array of integers, meaning the hours to apply the recurrence to.
ACk.name: by_hour

ACl.caption: By Minute
ACl.doc: If given, it must be either an integer, or an array of integers, meaning the minutes to apply the recurrence to.
ACl.name: by_minute

ACm.caption: By Second
ACm.doc: If given, it must be either an integer, or an array of integers, meaning the seconds to apply the recurrence to.
ACm.name: by_second

ACx.caption: By Week Day
ACx.doc: If given, it must be an integer (0 == RRule.MO), or an array of integers.  The default week start is "monday" = 0.
ACx.name: by_week_day
